title: AI policy
why_it_matters_here: The firm's AI policy sets principles for developing and using AI; this agent must be covered by it.

title: Alignment with other organizational policies
why_it_matters_here: The AI policy is kept consistent with security, privacy and conduct policies; the legal register supports this.

title: Review of the AI policy
why_it_matters_here: The AI policy is reviewed on a schedule and after significant change.

title: AI roles and responsibilities
why_it_matters_here: Owner, approver and oversight roles for the agent are assigned.

title: Reporting of concerns
why_it_matters_here: Staff and customers can raise concerns about the agent's behaviour.

title: Resource documentation
why_it_matters_here: The agent's components, identities, models, tools and data sources are documented.

title: Data resources
why_it_matters_here: Data the agent uses (knowledge sources, session memory, evaluation data) is identified and controlled.

title: Tooling resources
why_it_matters_here: Tools and tool servers the agent can call are identified and controlled.

title: System and computing resources
why_it_matters_here: Compute and capacity are planned, and limits protect them.

title: Human resources
why_it_matters_here: People who build, approve and oversee the agent have the competence and trust the role needs.

title: AI system impact assessment process
why_it_matters_here: A defined process assesses what the agent could do to people and society.

title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
why_it_matters_here: Impact assessment results are recorded.

title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
why_it_matters_here: Effects on customers (wrong information, privacy, manipulation, unequal service) are assessed.

title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
why_it_matters_here: Wider effects are considered; for a narrow service agent they are small, and the assessment says so.

title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
why_it_matters_here: Stated objectives (for example fairness, safety, transparency) guide how the agent is built.

title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
why_it_matters_here: Design and build steps include the guardrails and reviews.

title: AI system requirements and specification
why_it_matters_here: What the agent must and must not do is specified, including limits and the refusal scope.

title: Documentation of AI system design and development
why_it_matters_here: Design choices and changes are recorded.

title: AI system verification and validation
why_it_matters_here: Evaluation and tests show the agent behaves as specified before release.

title: AI system deployment
why_it_matters_here: Release follows a gated, documented process.

title: AI system operation and monitoring
why_it_matters_here: Behaviour is monitored in production, with ability to intervene.

title: AI system technical documentation
why_it_matters_here: Technical documentation is kept current.

title: AI system recording of event logs
why_it_matters_here: Events are logged so behaviour can be reconstructed.

title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
why_it_matters_here: No model is trained or fine-tuned here; this applies to evaluation data and prompts used to improve the agent.

title: Acquisition of data
why_it_matters_here: No training data is acquired. Knowledge sources the agent answers from are covered under data provenance (A.7.5).

title: Quality of data for AI systems
why_it_matters_here: Knowledge sources the agent relies on are accurate and current.

title: Data provenance
why_it_matters_here: The origin of the knowledge sources and evaluation data is recorded.

title: Data preparation
why_it_matters_here: Data is cleaned and redacted before it reaches the model.

objective: Information for interested parties of AI systems
title: System documentation and information for users
why_it_matters_here: Customers are told what the agent is and what it can do.

objective: Information for interested parties of AI systems
title: External reporting
why_it_matters_here: Obligations to report to regulators or other external parties are known and followed.

objective: Information for interested parties of AI systems
title: Communication of incidents
why_it_matters_here: Incidents are communicated to affected parties and authorities in time.

objective: Information for interested parties of AI systems
title: Information for interested parties
why_it_matters_here: Customers, staff and regulators get the information they need about the agent.

title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
why_it_matters_here: Rules and processes govern how the agent is used, including human approval and handoff.

title: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
why_it_matters_here: Objectives for responsible use are set and measured.

title: Intended use of the AI system
why_it_matters_here: The agent is used only for its stated purpose; out-of-scope requests are refused.

title: Allocating responsibilities
why_it_matters_here: Responsibilities between the firm, the model provider and other suppliers are agreed.

title: Suppliers
why_it_matters_here: Suppliers of models, tools and services are assessed and monitored.

title: Customers
why_it_matters_here: The firm meets its responsibilities to the customers who use the agent.
